title: Bar Service Sign-In Sheet Form
subtitle: Record assigned bar personnel, responsible-review status, station briefing, attendance, issued property, relief handoffs, and accountable departure.
description: An original operational attendance and handoff sheet for beverage-service staff and approved contractors. It links each worker to a reviewed role, station, shift, briefing, issued property, relief handoff, exception record, and sign-out without collecting payroll or identity-document details.
use_case: Use at service-lead check-in before a worker enters an assigned bar station. Record the responsible role's credential or assignment review result rather than copying personal documents. Close after people and issued property reconcile and every missing handoff has an owner.

sections.title: Sheet control and service routing
sections.guidance: Tie attendance to the current bar order, service lead, and review source.

sections.title: Approved roles and station assignments
sections.guidance: Confirm the expected team before attendance is recorded.

blocks.label: Approved assignment reference
blocks.guidance: Record the result of responsible review; do not copy license, permit, or identity-document numbers.

blocks.label: Roster controls
items: Current order and assignment plan are available
Responsible-role review status is recorded for each assignment
Station leads and relief coverage are identified
Setup, service, and closeout roles are covered
Outside contractor contact and venue sponsor are recorded
Unlisted or changed assignments have an approval route

sections.title: Team sign-in, station, and sign-out
sections.guidance: Record only operational attendance and assignment details.

sections.title: Briefing and issued-property custody
sections.guidance: Confirm the service briefing and track operational property.

blocks.label: Briefing acknowledgment topics
items: Authorized service scope, stations, and times reviewed
Applicable age-verification process reviewed
Service-refusal and manager-escalation route reviewed
Nonalcoholic and water support reviewed
Ingredient-question routing reviewed
Incident and emergency route reviewed
Cash, payment, product, key, and device custody reviewed
Relief handoff, last-service, and closeout duties reviewed

blocks.label: Issued property register
blocks.guidance: Do not record payment credentials or access codes.

sections.title: Attendance exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Hold unreviewed assignments and preserve the current staffing decision.

blocks.label: Exception triggers
items: Worker or contractor is not on the assignment plan
Responsible-review status is missing or unclear
Assigned station or role differs from the current order
Briefing is incomplete or an instruction is unresolved
Relief coverage or required role is absent
Issued property cannot be accounted for
Worker leaves without an operational handoff
Attendance count cannot be reconciled

blocks.label: Assignment and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This sheet records operational attendance and the result of responsible-role review. It does not independently certify a license, authorize alcohol service, determine employment status, or replace applicable policy. Do not copy identity documents, license numbers, payroll data, or payment credentials.

sections.title: Attendance reconciliation and closeout
sections.guidance: Close after people, property, and station handoffs are accounted for.

blocks.label: Closeout confirmations
items: Checked-in and checked-out totals compared
Workers still on duty transferred to a named lead
Relief and station-close handoffs recorded
Keys, radios, and payment devices reconciled
Attendance exceptions have dispositions or owners
Related incidents retain their own qualified records
Completed sheet stored with appropriate access
